title: Forget Traditional Car Detailing (This is So Much Better)
promo_conflict: Alan promotes the Go Detail licensing system, and Miguel is featured as a top student describing results after joining it. The transcript does not disclose the license terms or independently verify the financial claims.

idea.name: Go Detail car detailing and vehicle care
idea.one_liner: Mobile and shop-based car detailing, with ceramic coating, window tint and PPF upsells, sold to car owners through local search and advertising.
idea.customer: Car owners booking mobile or shop-based vehicle care.
idea.offer: Interior and exterior detailing, ceramic coating, paint correction, window tint and PPF.
idea.revenue_model: Per-job service fees and higher-priced add-ons or packages; some work is fulfilled by technicians and service partners.

idea.name: Industrial ceramic coating for equipment
idea.one_liner: Apply protective and restorative ceramic coating to farm, construction and commercial equipment, charging per machine or job.
idea.customer: Construction companies, contractors, farm operators and owners of heavy equipment.
idea.offer: Prepare and coat tractors, trailers, dump trucks, ambulances and other heavy equipment to limit rust, fading and oxidation.
idea.revenue_model: Project-based fees priced by machine or job; undercoating and rust-proofing can be additional services.
